item.title: From the sports desk: The 'Quad God' is mortal
item.description: Hello from Milan and Cortina, where the unthinkable happened today inside the Milano Ice Skating Arena.

item.title: Stakes climb as U.S. women advance to hockey semifinals
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey team didn't celebrate after their thumping of Canada ended their preliminary round undefeated.

item.title: Ukrainian athlete seeking to honor killed countrymen loses appeal to compete at Olympics
item.description: Ukrainian skeleton racer Vladyslav Heraskevych remains barred from Olympic competition, the Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled Friday, upholding his earlier disqualification for wearing a “helmet of remembrance” for his countrymen killed by Russia

item.title: These two athletes could deliver South America's first medals in the Winter Games
item.description: Alpine skier Lucas Pinheiro Braathen and skeleton competitor Nicole Rocha Silveira, both from Brazil, will compete this weekend in the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: ‘Quad God’ Ilia Malinin falls and fails to medal
item.description: American Ilia Malinin struggled through his free skate, falling twice and failing to medal. He was the heavy favorite for gold but told reporters after there is nothing like Olympic pressure. NBC News’ Tom Llamas reports.

item.title: Don Lemon pleads not guilty to Minnesota church protest charges
item.description: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon pleaded not guilty on Friday to charges connected to his coverage of protests over federal immigration enforcement in Minnesota.

item.title: 'Even in Russia, they don't treat children like this': A family's nightmare in ICE detention
item.description: A Russian family sought asylum in the United States. In the Dilley ICE detention center in Texas, they say their children endured worms in the food and hourslong waits for medication.

item.title: Two federal agents on leave over 'untruthful' remarks about violent Minneapolis encounter
item.description: A federal prosecutor is seeking to dismiss charges against two men involved in what authorities described as a violent altercation with immigration agents in Minneapolis last month.

item.title: Homeland Security Department shuts down as Democrats and Trump negotiate changes
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security shut down as Trump and Democrats continued to discuss changes to U.S. immigration enforcement after the Minneapolis shootings.

item.title: Sheriff defends handling of evidence in search for Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos tells NBC News investigators are pursuing “good leads” in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie and denied reports of tension with the FBI. NBC News' Liz Kreutz reports.
